title: Annotatio V §.XII (3): Hulsemann — judgment of Reformed doctrine includes their doctors
pass_a_gloss: (3.) Of HULSEMANN, whom the Author declares — even against all sense — to have spoken only of Auditors and Laity among the Reformed, not of Doctors and Clergy: For to pass judgment on the Reformed’ doctrine and yet not glance at their Doctors is as irrational as it is most alien to Hülsemannian accuracy and acumen.
pass_b_english: (3) Hulsemann: the Author claims — against all sense — he spoke only of Reformed auditors and laity, not doctors and clergy.
To judge Reformed doctrine while ignoring their doctors is irrational and alien to Hülsemann’s accuracy.
source_text: (3.) HULSEMANNI, quem de solis Auditoribus & Laicis inter Reformatos, non autem de Doctoribus & Clero, verba fecisse, vel contra omnem sensum, enuntiat Aut.: Nam de Reformatorum doctrina judicium ferre, nec tamen Doctores eorum subinuere, uti alogon, ita ab accuratione & acumine Hülsemanniano alienissimum existit.
